text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate on model-runner-usw2. 5m error rate=8.3% (1200 errors). Pager: @maya

maya-oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Where's the latest logs?

juan-sre: attaching cluster summary inline snippet:
```
runtime: model-runner-7f9c
error: SIGSEGV at 0x7ff... oom_kill_process
stack: inference_loop+0x24f
```

juan-sre: seeing repeated segfault + OOM on node gpu-az1-3 starting 23:02 UTC

arun-runtime: on it. Probable memory leak in quant attention kernel. Immediate mitigation: take node out of rotation, reroute traffic to fallback model variant, lower concurrency.

arun-runtime: run:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-az1-3
kubectl drain gpu-az1-3 --ignore-daemonsets --force
redwoodctl routes reroute --from us-west-2 --to us-east-1 --service model-runner --weight 100
```

emily-support: Customer impact: multiple 502 reports from acme.co (prod) and beta.ai (staging->prod). Support escalated to P1, customers notified with status page link.

maya-oncall: Doing the cordon+drain, initiating reroute. Also starting auto-scaler bump.

juan-sre: scaling pool up (adds 4 nodes) and enabling prefix KV cache bypass for affected model:
```
redwoodctl pool scale --name model-runner-usw2 --add 4
redwoodctl config set model-runner kv_cache.enabled=false --scope temp
```

arun-runtime: after reroute and scale, lower max_concurrency on new pods to 4 and set fallback model gpt-medium-quant for quality guardrails.

maya-oncall: handoff: @sara-oncall will take after I step out in 15m. summary: segfault+OOM on gpu-az1-3 causing 5xx surge. Actions: cordon/drain node, scale +4, reroute traffic to us-east-1, enable fallback model gpt-medium-quant, disable kv_cache on affected model.

sara-oncall: ack, taking over. I'll monitor and follow runbook. Any idea if this is correlated with recent quant kernel deploy?

arun-runtime: yes, there's a canary pushed 02:15 UTC to quant-kernel 1.2.7. We're rolling it back on affected hosts.

juan-sre: rollback command:
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --component quant-kernel --version 1.2.6 --scope model-runner-usw2
```

kate-custops: Customer ops update: notified Acme and Beta with eta 30m for full verification, provided workaround to use alternate region endpoint.

emily-support: error rate now 0.7% over 5m, latency back to normal for most flows. Closing customer P1 escalation if stable.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: error rate normalized after reroute + scale + rollback. Incident closed. Refer to incident runbook IR-8123456789 for postmortem.

maya-oncall: leaving note: followup required - reproduce memory leak in quant attention, schedule hotfix and regression tests. I'll create ticket.

sara-oncall: noted, will own follow-ups.
